groups.condition: CHARBOUND and STRIPCC are combined, with retained text followed by a stripped control.
groups.capability: Retain the boundary marker before surviving text and remove the marker immediately before the stripped control.
groups.consequence: The old harness may fail to exercise this combined behavior.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same marker handling, flag combination, and potential harness gap.

groups.operation: Convert LF to U+2028 using NLF2LS.
groups.condition: NLF2LS is selected without STRIPCC, with an unrelated control such as a tab present.
groups.capability: Convert LF while preserving the unrelated control.
groups.consequence: The old harness may fail to exercise this option combination.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same LF conversion, tab preservation, and potential harness gap.
